step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an event-driven notification flow starting with SNS delivering messages to SQS, which triggers Lambda. Lambda then processes notifications by communicating with RDS, persisting history to DynamoDB, sending mobile SMS alerts, dispatching email via SES, and pushing updates to a Web UI.

graph.name: Mueller Water Products Real-Time Serverless Notification System
graph.notes: Serverless real-time notification engine for water infrastructure IoT alerts.
